verdict.exact_s10_purpose: Memory-traffic, bank-stall and alternative-mechanism screening only; not product-lane balancing.

product_issue.reason: All Cout values are multiples of 96. Each legal source-tap emits q complete 96-channel vectors, so A1 reaches P/96 cycles with 100% useful lanes. Boundary 4/6/9 changes vector count but never creates a partial vector.

descriptor_decode.reason: Even D2/D3 boundary events occupy at least four product-issue cycles; D0/D1 occupy at least 16/8. A one-event-at-a-time expander with a small FIFO can stay ahead without concurrent source bundling.

weight_fetch.reason: One issued vector consumes one 96-weight vector. With the same weight ports, EPD cannot exceed A1 steady-state issue bandwidth. Any weight-vector cache, prefetch or reuse used by EPD must also be given to the strong A1; product-similarity reuse must be compared directly with Prosperity.

psum_update.reason: Source ordering can create psum bank/RAW stalls, but deterministic parity banking, forwarding and the same bounded queues are legal A1 infrastructure. If EPD and A1 share those mechanisms and ports, multi-source reordering has no intrinsic cycle advantage. A fundamentally different output-resident dataflow must be evaluated as a new memory mechanism, not as the killed scheduler.

output_commit.reason: Exact computation fixes the set of output vectors and values. Reordering source events does not reduce the 1,104,000 96-channel vector commits/frame. Only legal producer-consumer fusion or compression can change movement.

bank_conflict.reason: If deterministic destination/parity banking is offered only to EPD, the baseline is artificially weak. If it is offered to A1, scheduler benefit disappears unless exact traces prove residual port stalls. Concurrent spike decode, bank-aware dispatch and OOO conflict removal also directly collide with FireFly-T.

prior_art_boundaries.work: Efficient Hardware Acceleration of Sparsely Active Convolutional SNNs
prior_art_boundaries.boundary: Compressed spike queues, self-timed event scheduling and interlaced state memories are prior art; do not claim the event queue or generic bank organization.
Concurrent nonzero-spike extraction, load balancing, weight dispatch and out-of-order bank-conflict elimination are direct neighbors to the killed EPD scheduler.
Combinatorial similarity and inner-product result reuse define the product-sparsity comparison if a decoder mechanism tries to reduce products rather than memory traffic.
Skipping inserted zeros/polyphase decomposition and speedup over a naive transposed-convolution implementation are prior art, not EPD/A1 novelty.

at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.mechanism: Invert the exact bitmaps into four deterministic output-parity gather streams. Hold one 96-channel output slice in a local accumulator while iterating its 1/2/2/4 spatial source neighborhood and active Cin entries, then commit once. This targets psum SRAM RMW traffic, not product count or lane balance.
at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.why_not_direct_sne_firefly_prosperity_ov: It uses output ownership to eliminate global psum residency and completion conflicts rather than compressed source queues, multi-spike OOO load balancing, or product-similarity reuse. Conventional output-stationary dataflow remains important prior art, so novelty is only the exact bitmap plus transposed-parity completion specialization.
exact_s10_measurements: Per-output-vector contribution-count histogram by parity, boundary and layer.
Bitmap scan/decode cycles and bytes versus source-descriptor cycles/bytes.
Weight-vector fetches/cache hits, local accumulator lifetime and output commits.
Same-port total cycles versus source-centric A1 with deterministic parity banking and a fair bounded psum cache.
at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.fastkill: KILL if it is not >=1.30x total memory-aware cycles versus the strong banked/cache-matched A1, or if an output-stationary A1 with the same bitmap reader is algebraically identical. Never report its psum-traffic ratio as cycle speedup.

at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.mechanism: For fixed decoder weights, compute y0=W*x0+b and yt=y(t-1)+W*(xt-x(t-1)) for t>0. Binary ATLIF source changes become signed delta events. The recurrence is exact only with a checkpoint-bound value scale, sufficient accumulator width and a canonical accumulation order.
at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.why_not_direct_sne_firefly_prosperity_ov: It exploits temporal-state recurrence rather than event-queue scheduling, OOO bank balancing or combinatorial product similarity. It is adjacent to DeltaCNN and therefore must cite and differentiate from that work; the plausible narrow seam is exact T10 binary-ATLIF ConvTranspose2d with explicit parity boundaries and fully charged on-chip state.
exact_s10_measurements: Boundary-weighted products for x0 plus every XOR transition x_t XOR x_(t-1), with add/sub sign counts.
Exact output miter against canonical A1 for every layer/sample/timestep.
Previous-bitmap and previous-output SRAM capacity, reads/writes, latency and energy.
Total cycles after state movement, not delta-product ratio alone.
at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.state_cost_floor: One previous-timestep packed source bitmap is 0.830 MiB across four layers. Previous output state is 20.215 MiB at INT16 or 30.322 MiB at Acc24 across four layers; layer-serial D3 peak is 14.063/21.094 MiB.
at_most_two_conditional_decoder_mechanis.fastkill: KILL immediately if P_delta/P_A1 >= 0.7692, because even zero-cost state cannot reach 1.30x compute speedup. Otherwise require >=1.30x memory-aware total cycles after all state SRAM traffic and zero exact mismatches.
